nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger: New Waitlist Entry

parameters.subject: =✅ You're on the Waitlist - Dr. Jennifer's Clinic
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.firstName }},

Thank you for joining our appointment waitlist!

📋 Your Waitlist Details:
  • Name: {{ $json.patientName }}
  • Phone: {{ $json.patientPhone }}
  • Email: {{ $json.patientEmail }}
  • Joined: {{ $json.signupDate }}

🔔 What Happens Next?

When an appointment slot becomes available (due to cancellation or reschedule), we'll send you an email notification. The notification will include:
  • Date and time of the available slot
  • Doctor name
  • Appointment type
  • Direct booking link

⚡ First to book gets the appointment! When you receive a notification, click the booking link quickly to claim the slot.

💡 Tips:
  • Check your email regularly (including spam folder)
  • Make sure {{ $json.patientEmail }} is correct
  • Respond quickly when notified (slots fill fast!)

📞 Questions?
Call us at: (XXX) XXX-XXXX
Or reply to this email.

We'll notify you as soon as a slot opens up!

Best regards,
Dr. Jennifer's Clinic Team

---
This is an automated confirmation email. Please do not reply directly unless you have questions.
